_meta.note: TDS data types. TYPE_INFO = TypeByte + optional length/precision/scale/collation. TYPE_VARBYTE = TYPE_INFO + value bytes.

FIXEDLENTYPE.description: Fixed-length types. TYPE_INFO = just the type byte. No length field. Value is always full width.

BYTELEN_TYPE.description: Variable-length types with 1-byte max length in TYPE_INFO, 1-byte actual length prefix on value.
BYTELEN_TYPE.type_info_size: 1 type byte + 1 MaxLen byte (+ precision/scale bytes for decimal/numeric/datetime2/time/datetimeoffset)
BYTELEN_TYPE.value_encoding: ActualLen(BYTE) + data bytes. ActualLen=0 means NULL.

USHORTLEN_TYPE.description: Variable-length types with 2-byte max length in TYPE_INFO, 2-byte actual length prefix on value.
USHORTLEN_TYPE.type_info_size: 1 type byte + 2 MaxLen bytes (+ 5-byte collation for char/varchar/nchar/nvarchar)
USHORTLEN_TYPE.value_encoding: ActualLen(USHORT) + data bytes. ActualLen=0xFFFF means NULL (for non-PLP). For PLP types (varchar/nvarchar/varbinary MAX), use PARTLENTYPE encoding.

LONGLEN_TYPE.description: Large object types with 4-byte max length. Deprecated in TDS 7.2+, use PARTLENTYPE instead.
LONGLEN_TYPE.type_info_size: 1 type byte + 4 MaxLen bytes (+ 5-byte collation for text/ntext)
LONGLEN_TYPE.value_encoding: For TEXT/NTEXT/IMAGE in ROW token: TextPointer(B_VARBYTE) + Timestamp(8BYTE) + DataLen(LONG) + data. DataLen=-1 means NULL (GEN_NULL). TextPointer absent if NULL.

PARTLENTYPE.description: Partially Length-Prefixed (PLP) streaming for MAX types and JSON/XML/UDT. Allows streaming without knowing total length.
PARTLENTYPE.type_info_size: 1 type byte + 2 bytes (0xFFFF for MAX length indicator) + optional collation/precision
PARTLENTYPE.value_encoding: TotalLen(ULONGLONG: 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFE=unknown, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF=NULL) + chunks: ChunkLen(ULONG)+data ... terminated by ChunkLen=0

types.name: null
types.description: Null type

types.name: tinyInt
types.description: 1-byte unsigned integer (0-255). Wire type is UInt8. TINYINT is the ONLY unsigned integer type in SQL Server — all other integer types (SMALLINT, INT, BIGINT) are signed.

conversion_safety.issue: Because TINYINT is unsigned (0-255, UInt8), converting to signed types narrower than 16 bits (e.g., Int8, range -128..127) will trap/crash for values > 127.
conversion_safety.rule: Implementations MUST use non-trapping initializers (e.g., Swift `I(exactly:)` or `I(clamping:)`) when converting TINYINT values to generic or potentially-narrower signed integer types. Never use `I(value)` where I is a generic FixedWidthInteger — it traps on overflow.
conversion_safety.example_bug: A generic function `fwi<I: FixedWidthInteger>() -> I` using `I(uint8Value)` crashes with 'Not enough bits to represent the passed value' when I=Int8 and value > 127.
conversion_safety.safe_pattern: Use `I(exactly: uint8Value)` which returns nil instead of crashing, or `I(clamping: uint8Value)` which clamps to I.max.

types.name: bit
types.description: 1-byte bit value

types.name: smallInt
types.description: 2-byte signed integer

types.name: int
types.description: 4-byte signed integer

types.name: smallDateTime
types.description: 4-byte date+time: 2-byte days since 1900-01-01 + 2-byte minutes since midnight

types.name: real
types.description: 4-byte IEEE 754 float

types.name: money
types.description: 8-byte fixed-point monetary value

types.name: datetime
types.description: 8-byte datetime: 4-byte days since 1900-01-01 + 4-byte 1/300-sec since midnight

types.name: float
types.description: 8-byte IEEE 754 double

types.name: smallMoney
types.description: 4-byte fixed-point monetary value

types.name: bigInt
types.description: 8-byte signed integer

types.name: guid
types.description: GUID/UUID. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(1)=16. Value: ActualLen(1, 0=NULL, 16=present) + 16 bytes little-endian.
types.encoding_note: Wire byte order for GUID: bytes 0-3 are little-endian int32, bytes 4-5 are little-endian int16, bytes 6-7 are little-endian int16, bytes 8-15 big-endian.

types.name: intn
types.description: Nullable integer. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(1)=[1,2,4,8]. Value: ActualLen(1, 0=NULL) + data. MaxLen 1=tinyint, 2=smallint, 4=int, 8=bigint.
notes: Use intn in RPC requests for int/smallint/tinyint/bigint nullable parameters
MaxLen=1 (tinyint): value is unsigned UInt8 (0-255). See tinyInt conversion_safety — the same unsigned-to-signed pitfall applies when converting intn(1) values to signed integer types.

types.name: bitn
types.description: Nullable bit. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(1)=1. Value: ActualLen(1, 0=NULL, 1=present) + 1 byte.

types.name: decimal
types.description: Fixed-precision decimal. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(1)=17 + Precision(1,0-38) + Scale(1,0-precision). Value: ActualLen(1, 0=NULL) + sign(1, 0=negative, 1=positive) + magnitude(ActualLen-1 bytes, little-endian).
notes: In RPC requests: Microsoft JDBC sends MaxLen=0x11(17), Precision=38(MAX). Scale may or may not appear in TYPE_INFO (use TDS_RPC_DEC_TYPEINFO_SCALE=1 env var in sqlserver-nio to include it)
Value payload: 1-byte sign + variable-length little-endian magnitude. Sign: 0x01=positive, 0x00=negative (per JDBC convention)

types.name: fltn
types.description: Nullable float. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(1)=[4,8]. Value: ActualLen(1, 0=NULL) + data. MaxLen 4=real(float32), 8=float(float64).

types.name: moneyn
types.description: Nullable money. MaxLen 4=smallmoney, 8=money.

types.name: datetimn
types.description: Nullable datetime. MaxLen 4=smalldatetime, 8=datetime.

types.name: date
types.description: Date only (no time). TYPE_INFO: type(1) only (no MaxLen byte — length implicit=3). Value: ActualLen(1, 0=NULL, 3=present) + 3 bytes (days since 0001-01-01, little-endian unsigned 24-bit).

types.name: time
types.description: Time only. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + Scale(1, 0-7). Scale determines byte count: 0-2→3 bytes, 3-4→4 bytes, 5-7→5 bytes. Value: ActualLen(1, 0=NULL) + data (unsigned integer, little-endian, representing 10^(-scale) second intervals since midnight).

types.name: datetime2
types.description: Datetime2. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + Scale(1, 0-7). Byte count = time_bytes + 3 (for date). Value: ActualLen(1, 0=NULL) + time_value (little-endian) + date_value (3 bytes, days since 0001-01-01).

types.name: dateTimeOffset
types.description: Datetime with timezone offset. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + Scale(1, 0-7). Total bytes = datetime2_bytes + 2 (for offset in minutes, signed INT16 little-endian).

types.name: charLegacy
types.description: Legacy fixed-length char. Use BIGCHARTYPE (0xAF) for TDS 7+.

types.name: varcharLegacy
types.description: Legacy varchar. Use BIGVARCHARTYPE (0xA7) for TDS 7+.

types.name: binaryLegacy
types.description: Legacy binary.

types.name: varbinaryLegacy
types.description: Legacy varbinary.

types.name: varbinary
types.description: Variable-length binary. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(2, 0-8000 or 0xFFFF for MAX). Value: ActualLen(2) + data. 0xFFFF = NULL. For VARBINARY(MAX): use PARTLENTYPE with MaxLen=0xFFFF.
types.plp_notes: VARBINARY(MAX) uses PLP encoding: TotalLen(8) + chunks. sqlserver-nio does NOT currently support PLP for varbinary(max).

types.name: varchar
types.description: Variable-length char. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(2, 0-8000 or 0xFFFF for MAX) + Collation(5 bytes). Value: ActualLen(2) + UTF-8 or Latin-1 bytes. 0xFFFF = NULL.
types.plp_notes: VARCHAR(MAX) uses PLP encoding. sqlserver-nio does NOT currently support PLP for varchar(max).

types.name: binary
types.description: Fixed-length binary padded to MaxLen. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(2). Value: ActualLen(2) + data.

types.name: char
types.description: Fixed-length char padded to MaxLen. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(2) + Collation(5 bytes). Value: ActualLen(2) + data.

types.name: nvarchar
types.description: Variable-length Unicode (UTF-16LE). TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(2, byte count: 0-8000, or 0xFFFF for MAX) + Collation(5 bytes). Value: ActualLen(2) + UTF-16LE bytes. 0xFFFF = NULL. NOTE: MaxLen is in BYTES; for nvarchar(4000) MaxLen=8000.
types.plp_notes: NVARCHAR(MAX) uses PLP encoding. sqlserver-nio caps at 4000 chars (8000 bytes) — no PLP support yet.

types.name: nchar
types.description: Fixed-length Unicode (UTF-16LE) padded to MaxLen bytes. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(2) + Collation(5). Value: ActualLen(2) + UTF-16LE bytes.

types.name: text
types.description: Large text (legacy LOB). TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(4) + Collation(5). In COLMETADATA: followed by TableName. In ROW: TextPointer(B_VARBYTE) + Timestamp(8) + DataLen(4) + data. DataLen=-1 means NULL.
notes: Requires TextPointer + Timestamp in ROW token unless NULL

types.name: image
types.description: Large binary (legacy LOB). Same structure as TEXT but no collation.

types.name: nText
types.description: Large Unicode text (legacy LOB). Like TEXT but UTF-16LE. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(4) + Collation(5).

types.name: sqlVariant
types.description: SQL_VARIANT can hold values of most SQL types. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(4)=8009. Value: DataLen(4) + BaseType(1) + PropLen(1) + PropertyBytes(PropLen) + BaseValue.
notes: Inner base type determines actual value encoding
PropertyBytes contain type-specific metadata (collation for char types, precision/scale for decimal, etc.)

types.name: xml
types.description: XML data. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + SchemaPresent(1, 0 or 1) + if SchemaPresent: DB(B_USVAR) + Schema(B_USVAR) + Collection(US_VARCHAR). Value: PLP encoding (TotalLen(8) + chunks).

types.name: clrUdt
types.description: CLR UDT. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(2) + DB(B_USVAR) + Schema(B_USVAR) + TypeName(B_USVAR) + AssemblyName(US_VARCHAR). Value: PLP encoding.

types.name: json
types.description: JSON data. TYPE_INFO: type(1) only (MaxLen implicit = 0xFFFF marker, no additional TYPE_INFO bytes). Value: PLP encoding with UTF-8 encoded JSON text.
notes: Only available when JSONSUPPORT FeatureExt negotiated (JSONSUPPORT_VERSION=1)
In sqlserver-nio COLMETADATA parser: length set to 0xFFFF, no additional bytes read for TYPE_INFO

types.name: vector
types.description: Vector type for similarity search. TYPE_INFO: type(1) + MaxLen(2, max bytes) + DimensionType(1, 0=float32). Value: ActualLen(2) + raw bytes.
types.scale_note: The DimensionType byte is read in the 'scale' position
notes: Only available when VECTORSUPPORT FeatureExt negotiated (VECTORSUPPORT_VERSION=1)
DimensionType=0 means float32 (4 bytes per element)
In sqlserver-nio COLMETADATA parser: reads USHORTLEN then reads DimensionType as a dummy byte

type_info_composition.description: How TYPE_INFO is composed for each category
